en.cam.panel.bad_tool_number: The tool number is a whole number from 1 to 99.
en.cam.panel.bad_diameter: Type the tool's diameter in mm.
en.cam.panel.pick_floor: Select the pocket's floor face in the model, then Add Operation.

en.cam.panel.pick_edges: Select the holes' round edges in the model, then Add Operation.
en.cam.panel.face_hint: Facing flattens the stock's top down to the part's top.
en.cam.panel.add_a_tool: Add a tool and a setup first.
en.help.cam.generate: Opens the Machining window: tools, setups and operations for your CNC router, with their toolpaths and G-code export. Use it to turn a part into GRBL programs, one per tool.
en.cam.error.too_deep: {depth} mm deep is more than {tool}'s flute length ({flute} mm)
en.cam.error.bottom_below_top: the bottom must be below the top
en.cam.error.safe_height: the safe height must be above the top of the material and the retract
en.cam.error.too_many_passes: too many passes: make the depth per pass larger
en.cam.error.face_empty: the area to face is empty
en.cam.error.too_many_facing_lines: too many facing lines: make the stepover larger
en.cam.error.too_many_rings: too many pocket rings: make the stepover larger
en.cam.error.tabs_size: tabs need a width and a height
en.cam.error.no_holes: there are no holes to drill
en.cam.error.hole_position: a hole's position is not a number
en.cam.error.peck: the peck depth must be more than 0 mm
en.cam.error.diameter: the diameter must be between 0 and 100 mm
en.cam.error.flute_length: the flute length must be more than 0 mm
en.cam.error.flutes: a tool needs at least one flute
en.cam.error.margins: the stock margins must be between 0 and 1000 mm
en.cam.error.no_tool: there is no tool T{n} in the library
en.cam.error.depth: the depth must be more than 0 mm
en.cam.error.nothing_to_face: there is nothing to face: the stock has no margin above the part
en.cam.error.pocket_floor: pick the pocket's floor, a face that faces up in this setup
en.cam.error.not_on_face: the pick is not on a face
en.cam.error.not_level: the face is not level: it must face straight up or down
en.cam.error.not_circle: the edge is not a circle seen from above: pick a hole's round edge
en.cam.error.free_form: the face has a free-form edge, which can't be machined yet: only lines and arcs
en.cam.error.no_body_to_machine: the model has no body to machine
en.cam.error.several_bodies: the model has several bodies: name the one to machine with `body`
en.cam.error.tool_in_use: T{n} is used by {name}: change or delete that operation first
en.cam.panel.bad_flute: Type the flute length in mm, or leave it empty for four times the diameter.
en.help.cam.setup: Opens the Machining window to make a setup: the body, its material, the work origin and the stock around it. Make one before adding operations.
en.help.cam.tool: Opens the Machining window to add a cutter: its number, diameter and flute length. Add the end mills and drills you will put in the spindle.
en.help.cam.face: Flattens the top of the stock down to the part. Use it first when the stock is thicker than the part.
en.help.cam.pocket: Clears the material above a floor face, inside its outline. Select the floor of a recess in the model, then add it.
en.help.cam.contour: Cuts around a face's outline, outside, inside or on it, with tabs to hold the part. Use it to cut a part out of the stock.
en.help.cam.drill: Drills the holes whose round edges you select, with pecking if you like. Use it for screw holes.
en.help.cam.toolpaths: Shows or hides the setup's toolpaths and stock over the model. Use it to check where the cutter goes before exporting.
en.help.cam.export: Writes the setup's G-code for GRBL, one file per tool. Use it when the toolpaths look right, then open the files in your machine's control software.
en.cam.panel.finish_first: Finish the current sketch or command before entering Manufacture.
en.cam.panel.cutting_hint: Empty fields take the material's starting values. Stepover is a percentage of the tool's diameter.
en.cam.panel.nothing_to_simulate: There is nothing to simulate: the setup has no stock or no toolpaths that can be made.
en.help.cam.simulation: Plays the setup's toolpaths against its stock and shows the material being cut away. Use it to check for leftovers and cuts in the wrong place before exporting.
en.cam.panel.start_hint: Add a tool and a setup from the ribbon, then an operation: the setups and their operations are listed here.
en.cam.panel.offset_hint: The bottom comes from the model. Empty: exactly there (0.5 mm below the stock for a cut through the part). + leaves material; − goes deeper, only through the part.
en.cam.panel.lowest: Deepest point: {mm} mm below the stock's top
en.cam.error.below_model: only a cut that goes through the part can reach below where the model puts its bottom
en.cam.error.offset: the offset must be a number of mm
en.cam.error.gouge: the toolpath cuts into the model near ({x}, {y}, {z})
en.cam.panel.table_hint: Click the face that sits on the machine's table: Z comes out of it. Drag the X or Y arrow to turn the axes a quarter turn at a time.
en.cam.panel.vertex_hint: Click a vertex of the model for the work origin.
en.cam.error.table_axis: the face on the table must face along one of the model's axes
en.cam.error.stock_too_small: the part ({x} × {y} × {z} mm) doesn't fit in the stock
en.cam.error.stock_size: the stock's size must be between 0 and 10000 mm
en.cam.error.axes: the setup's axes are not square
en.cam.sim.shank_crash: the shank rubs on the material at ({x}, {y}, {z})
en.cam.panel.entry_hint: Automatic goes down the gentlest way that fits: a helix in a pocket, else a ramp along the cut, else straight down.
en.cam.lib.draw_hint: Enter a diameter to see the tool.
en.cam.lib.preset_hint: Leave a box empty to use the starting value for the material.
en.cam.lib.holder_sections: Give the holder at least one section with a diameter and a length.
en.cam.lib.empty: No tools yet: add one with New Tool.
en.cam.lib.pick_hint: Pick a tool or a holder on the left, or add a new one.
en.cam.lib.same: The same as in the tool library.
en.cam.lib.missing: No longer in the tool library.
en.cam.sim.holder_crash: the holder runs into the material at ({x}, {y}, {z})
en.help.cam.library: Keeps your tools and holders on this computer for every design. Copy one into a design to use it; a design keeps its copy wherever it is opened.

vi.cam.panel.vertex_hint: Nhấp vào một đỉnh của mô hình để làm gốc gia công.

vi.cam.panel.entry_hint: Tự động chọn cách vào dao nhẹ nhất vừa chỗ: xoắn ốc trong hốc, nếu không thì dốc nghiêng, nếu không nữa thì đâm thẳng.

vi.cam.lib.preset_hint: Để trống để dùng giá trị đầu của vật liệu.

vi.help.cam.library: Lưu dao và đầu kẹp trên máy này cho mọi thiết kế. Sao chép vào thiết kế để dùng; thiết kế giữ bản sao ở mọi nơi.

zh.cam.panel.bad_tool_number: 刀具编号是 1 到 99 的整数。
zh.cam.panel.pick_floor: 在模型中选择型腔的底面，然后点“添加工序”。
zh.cam.panel.pick_face: 选择要沿外形切割的面，然后点“添加工序”。
zh.cam.panel.pick_edges: 在模型中选择孔的圆边，然后点“添加工序”。
zh.cam.panel.face_hint: 平面铣把毛坯顶面铣平到零件顶面。
zh.help.cam.generate: 打开加工窗口：为 CNC 雕刻机管理刀具、设置和工序，查看刀具路径并导出 G 代码。用它把零件变成每把刀一个的 GRBL 程序。
zh.cam.panel.bad_flute: 请输入刃长（mm），留空则为直径的 4 倍。
zh.cam.error.too_deep: 深度 {depth} mm 超过了{tool}的刃长（{flute} mm）。请换刃更长的刀具或减小深度。
zh.cam.error.safe_height: 安全高度必须高于材料顶面和退刀高度。
zh.cam.error.too_many_passes: 分层次数太多：请加大每层切深。
zh.cam.error.too_many_facing_lines: 平面铣行数太多：请加大步距。
zh.cam.error.too_many_rings: 型腔环数太多：请加大步距。
zh.cam.error.tabs_size: 连接桥需要宽度和高度。
zh.cam.error.peck: 啄钻深度必须大于 0 mm。
zh.cam.error.diameter: 直径必须在 0 到 100 mm 之间。
zh.cam.error.margins: 毛坯余量必须在 0 到 1000 mm 之间。
zh.cam.error.nothing_to_face: 没有可铣平的部分：零件上方没有毛坯余量。
zh.cam.error.pocket_floor: 请选择型腔底面（在此设置中朝上的面）。
zh.cam.error.not_level: 该面不水平：必须正朝上或正朝下。
zh.cam.error.not_circle: 从上方看这条边不是圆：请选择孔的圆边。
zh.cam.error.free_form: 该面有自由曲线边，暂时无法加工：仅支持直线和圆弧。
zh.cam.error.no_body_to_machine: 模型中没有可加工的实体。
zh.cam.error.several_bodies: 模型有多个实体：请先选择要加工的实体再新建设置。
zh.cam.error.tool_in_use: T{n} 正被{name}使用：请先修改或删除该工序。
zh.help.cam.setup: 打开加工窗口新建设置：要加工的实体、材料、工件原点和周围的毛坯。添加工序前先建一个。
zh.help.cam.tool: 打开加工窗口添加刀具：编号、直径和刃长。添加要装在主轴上的立铣刀和钻头。
zh.help.cam.face: 把毛坯顶面铣平到零件高度。毛坯比零件厚时先用它。
zh.help.cam.pocket: 在所选底面的轮廓内铣到底面高度。先在模型中选择凹槽的底面再添加。
zh.help.cam.contour: 沿所选面的外形在外侧、内侧或线上切割，可加连接桥固定零件。用于从毛坯上切下零件。
zh.help.cam.drill: 钻出所选圆边对应的孔，可选啄钻。用于螺丝孔。
zh.help.cam.toolpaths: 在模型上显示或隐藏设置的刀具路径和毛坯。导出前用来检查刀具走向。
zh.help.cam.export: 为 GRBL 写出设置的 G 代码，每把刀一个文件。确认刀具路径后导出，再在机床控制软件中打开。
zh.cam.panel.finish_first: 进入制造前，请先完成当前的草图或命令。
zh.ui.workspace_manufacture_tabs: 设置 · 2D 铣削 · 检查 · 输出
zh.cam.panel.cutting_hint: 留空则使用材料的默认值。步距为刀具直径的百分比。
zh.cam.panel.nothing_to_simulate: 没有可模拟的内容：此设置没有毛坯或可生成的刀具路径。
zh.help.cam.simulation: 按设置的刀具路径在毛坯上回放，显示材料被切除的过程。导出前用来检查残留和错误切削。
zh.cam.panel.start_hint: 请先从功能区添加刀具和设置，再添加工序；设置和工序会列在这里。
zh.cam.panel.kept: 保持不变（重新选择以更改）
zh.cam.panel.offset_hint: 底部由模型决定。留空即为该位置（贯穿零件的加工为毛坯底部以下 0.5 mm）。+ 留料，− 更深（仅限贯穿加工）。
zh.cam.panel.lowest: 最深处：毛坯顶面以下 {mm} mm
zh.cam.error.below_model: 只有贯穿零件的加工才能低于模型决定的底部。
zh.cam.error.offset: 偏移必须是以 mm 为单位的数字。
zh.cam.error.gouge: 刀具路径会切入模型（靠近 {x}, {y}, {z}）。请换更细的刀具或检查形状。
zh.cam.panel.table_hint: 点击贴在机床工作台上的面：Z 轴从该面向外。拖动 X 或 Y 箭头可按 90° 旋转坐标轴。
zh.cam.panel.vertex_hint: 点击模型的一个顶点作为工件原点。
zh.cam.error.table_axis: 贴台面必须朝向模型的某一坐标轴方向。
zh.cam.error.stock_size: 毛坯尺寸必须在 0 到 10000 mm 之间。
zh.cam.error.axes: 设置的坐标轴互不垂直。
zh.cam.panel.entry_hint: 自动会选择能放下的最平缓方式：型腔用螺旋，否则沿路径斜线，再不行就直接下刀。
zh.cam.lib.draw_hint: 输入直径即可看到刀具图。
zh.cam.lib.preset_hint: 留空则使用该材料的初始值。
zh.cam.lib.holder_sections: 刀柄至少需要一段（直径和长度）。
zh.cam.lib.used: 已复制到此设计的刀具。
zh.cam.lib.empty: 还没有刀具：用“新刀具”添加。
zh.cam.lib.pick_hint: 在左侧选择刀具或刀柄，或新建。
zh.cam.lib.missing: 刀具库中已没有此刀具。
zh.help.cam.library: 在本机保存刀具和刀柄，供所有设计使用。复制到设计后，设计会保留副本。
